card.name: The word manual in procedures
card.fires_on: The word "manual" (or "manually") used as an adjective for hands-on methods, such as manual ventilation, compression, or administration. Also fires weakly on the start of "voluntary".

modes.label: Manual method
modes.description: "manual" describes a hands-on way of giving or performing something, often set against automated or mechanical.

modes.label: Manual ventilation
modes.description: "manual" before "or mechanical ventilation" in emergency care instructions.
modes.example: The patient’s airway should be assured, with<< manual>> or mechanical ventilation maintained as necessary.
